test_title: PYST 65: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘×’ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

78 − 6 ÷ 6 + 2 × 8 = ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] The original equation: 78 − 6 ÷ 6 + 2 × 8 = ? The given interchange rules are: ‘+’ ↔ ‘×’ and ‘−’ ↔ ‘÷’.
